text:
viv-peopleops: FYI we're publishing a small handbook patch tonight (v3.0.1) — consolidated parental leave examples + updated hybrid workspace etiquette. This will pair with a short compliance micro-course bundle (12-20m each). Managers asked to enroll teams by Jun 7.

nate-hr: The handbook diff will be in Confluence: Handbook > Releases > v3.0.1. We'll also pin a TL;DR in #announcements.

claire-manager: Quick Q — are these micro-courses mandatory for tenure reviews?

viv-peopleops: No, not mandatory. They are recommended for manager check-ins and visibility in the people dashboard. Completion flags will show up in manager exports.

devin-eng: Can managers assign different electives per direct? We have folks who only need the etiquette module.

viv-peopleops: Yes. You can pick electives per user in the enroll modal or via bulk CSV.

lms-bot: New flow: Manager enroll -> LMS sends enroll invite -> user completes module -> LMS posts ack back to People Console. Reminder cadence: 48h and 7d after enroll.

claire-manager: Contractor status? We have two vendors who should see etiquette but not safety compliance.

hr-ops: Contractors excluded by default. To request exception file an HR ticket with contractor_email + justification. We'll review and, if approved, add them with a contractor tag.

nate-hr: Privacy note: accommodation details must go through the HR ticket only. Do not add medical info to tracker comments.

viv-peopleops: Tracker link: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/example (managers get edit access after a short RSVP). CSV template name: peopleops_micro_enroll_v2.csv. Required columns: employee_email, employee_id, elective_code, enrolled_at, enrolled_by.

claire-manager: Will export include completed_at timestamp? I need that for 1:1 notes.

lms-bot: Exports include completed_at, enrollment_id, elective_code, ack_url. Available in People Console > Learning > Exports.

devin-eng: If the bulk CSV fails validation, what's the retry window?

viv-peopleops: Validation errors show a row id in the feedback file. Re-upload anytime. For large uploads we'll queue and email the manager when processing completes (usually < 2 hours).

claire-manager: SLA if I open a ticket for enrollment issues?

hr-ops: Please open #help with the tracker row id. We'll respond within 48 business hours.

nate-hr: Timeline: announce today; managers RSVP + bulk enroll by Jun 1; final enrollments Jun 7; reminders Jun 8-20; dashboard sync mid-June.

claire-manager: Thanks — I'll prep the CSV and ping if I hit any validation errors.

viv-peopleops: Thanks! If anyone wants a 15m walkthrough of the tracker and exports ping me and I'll set up a session. :calendar:
